274944284.description:
Cross
Classic Century Pen and Pencil Set - Chrome Finish
Vintage "Couples Gift" Edition, Original Case
This vintage Cross Classic Century set showcases the iconic slim silhouette and specialized engineering that have defined the brand since the mid-20th century. Featuring the distinctive black conical tops and a polished chrome finish, this set was marketed as a "Couples Gift," presented in a dedicated two-toned green and cream clamshell case. The Classic Century remains a staple of American writing instrument design, valued for its balanced weight and reliable twist-action mechanism.
Polished chrome-plated barrels with signature black conical end caps
Set includes one twist-action ballpoint pen and one matching mechanical pencil
Original vintage presentation box with "Couples Gift" silk lining and green textured exterior
Classic slim profile designed for ergonomic comfort and professional portability
Condition:
Very good vintage condition. The chrome finish on both writing instruments is bright with only minor surface micro-scratching consistent with light handling. Twist mechanisms on both pieces are intact with no visible damage. The presentation case is structurally sound with a functional hinge; internal silk lining shows minimal age-related wear. Exterior of the case is clean with crisp branding.
